Privacy Policy

BoltOra Studio

Last Updated: June 27, 2026

BoltOra Studio ("BoltOra", "we", "our", or "us") develops and publishes mobile games and digital entertainment products for players worldwide.

This Privacy Policy explains how information may be collected, used, stored, and protected when you access or use any mobile game, application, website, or service published by BoltOra Studio (collectively, the "Services").

By using our Services, you acknowledge and agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

1Information We Collect

1.1 Collected Automatically

When you use our Services, certain information may be collected automatically, including:

  • Device model and manufacturer
  • Device operating system and version
  • Language settings
  • Country and region
  • Time zone settings
  • Internet Protocol (IP) address
  • Mobile advertising identifiers
  • App version and build information
  • Gameplay activities and events
  • Session duration
  • Crash reports and diagnostic data
  • Device performance information

1.2 Voluntarily Provided

Some Services may allow you to contact us through email or support channels. In such cases, we may receive information that you voluntarily provide, including:

  • Name
  • Email address
  • Support request information
  • Other information included in your communication

You are responsible for ensuring that any information you provide is accurate and lawful.

2How We Use Information

We may use collected information for the following purposes:

Providing and operating our Services
Improving gameplay experience
Enhancing game performance and stability
Analyzing player engagement
Monitoring and preventing fraud or abuse
Responding to customer support inquiries
Delivering and measuring advertising performance
Complying with legal and regulatory obligations
Protecting the security of our Services

3Analytics Services

Our Services may use analytics technologies provided by trusted third parties, including Google Firebase Analytics.

These technologies help us understand how players interact with our Services and enable us to improve user experience, game balance, technical performance, and content quality.

Analytics providers may collect:

  • Device information
  • Gameplay events
  • Session activity
  • Geographic region
  • App usage statistics

More information about Firebase:

firebase.google.com/support/privacy →

4Advertising

Our Services may display advertisements through Google AdMob and other advertising partners. Advertising providers may collect and process information including:

Information collected:

  • Advertising identifiers
  • Device information
  • Interaction with advertisements
  • General location information
  • Performance and attribution data

Used to:

  • Deliver advertisements
  • Measure advertising effectiveness
  • Limit repetitive advertising
  • Detect invalid traffic and fraud
  • Improve advertising services
policies.google.com/technologies/ads →

5Data Sharing

BoltOra Studio does not sell personal information to third parties.

Information may be shared only in the following circumstances:

Service Providers

With trusted third-party providers that assist in operating our Services, including:

  • Analytics providers
  • Advertising networks
  • Cloud hosting providers
  • Security and fraud prevention providers

Legal Requirements

When required by applicable law, legal process, government request, court order, or regulatory obligation.

Business Transactions

In connection with a merger, acquisition, financing, sale of assets, or similar corporate transaction.

6International Data Transfers

Our Services are offered globally.

Information may be processed and stored on servers located outside your country of residence.

By using our Services, you acknowledge that information may be transferred to and processed in jurisdictions that may have different data protection laws than your country.

7Data Retention

We retain information only for as long as reasonably necessary to:

Provide our Services
Improve our products
Comply with legal obligations
Resolve disputes
Enforce our agreements

Retention periods may vary depending on the nature of the information and applicable legal requirements.

8Data Security

We implement commercially reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards designed to protect information from:

Unauthorized access
Unauthorized disclosure
Alteration
Loss
Misuse

Note: Despite these measures, no system or method of transmission over the Internet can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

9Children's Privacy

Our Services are intended for a general audience and are not specifically directed toward children under the age of 13.

We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 years of age.

If we become aware that personal information from a child under 13 has been collected without appropriate parental consent, we will take reasonable steps to delete such information.

Parents or guardians who believe that their child has provided personal information may contact us using the details below.

10Your Rights

Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have certain rights regarding your information, including:

Access to information
Correction of inaccurate information
Deletion of information
Restriction of processing
Objection to processing
Data portability

Requests may be submitted using the contact information provided below.

11Third-Party Services

Our Services may contain links to or integrate third-party services.

We are not responsible for the privacy practices, content, or policies of third-party websites, applications, or services.

Users should review the privacy policies of such third parties independently.

12Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may modify this Privacy Policy from time to time.

Any updates will be posted on this page with a revised "Last Updated" date.

Continued use of our Services following publication of changes constitutes acceptance of the updated Privacy Policy.

13Contact Us

For questions regarding this Privacy Policy or our privacy practices, please contact:

BoltOra Studio

Email: dev@globalmerchantsgame.com

Website: globalmerchantsgame.com

Support: support@globalmerchantsgame.com
